ModMetaData.name: Helodrace
ModMetaData.author: BlueBackedFish, formingrain
ModMetaData.description:
-start : BlueBackedFish or byeongsin -Race, cloth texture : formingrain
Helodrace adds the Helods, a standalone industrial-age frontier race. Build line-shaft factories, oil fields and steelworks, deal in Sthaler banknotes, and use the telegraph and radio to call caravans, loans and forward-base support. Era weapons and modular gear span the Wild West to the modern day.
Requires Harmony, Biotech and Helod race - Blanca's Drugs.
